svg.title: Three operands through two read ports
svg.desc: Three operands through two read ports; B · fused signed INT8 dot-product accumulation · functional schematic; Before capture: check RAW dependencies on rs1, rs2 and old(rd); wait if needed.; ID / operand collection; EX; Writeback; Register file; 2 reads · 1 write; R1: rs1 → rd; R2: rs2; Packed rs1; capture → hold; Packed rs2; capture → hold; DOT4; 4 signed INT8 pairs; sign extend → 32; +; MEM; ↓; WB; to rd; Step 2: R1 reads old(rd); old(rd); low 32 bits; READY ID STEP 1; Capture rs1 + rs2; set pending.; Hold IF/ID; inject a control bubble.; READY ID STEP 2; Keep packed inputs; sample old(rd).; Issue to EX; clear pending.; Ready steps exclude RAW waits and EX–MEM–WB latency; they are not a two-cycle instruction latency.
